chunks: Yūnus, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū Baṣīr, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “The fornicator, when he has been flogged three times, is killed on the fourth—meaning, when he has been flogged three times.”
And this report does not conflict with what he narrated:

key_terms.اَلزَّانِي: the fornicator; the person guilty of zina
key_terms.جُلِدَ: was flogged; received the hadd punishment of whipping

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shia hadith on a fornicator who is punished repeatedly for zina?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the repeated punishment of the fornicator, specifying that after being flogged three times, the person is killed on the fourth offense. The passage also indicates that this report is to be understood alongside another narration, showing concern for reconciling hadith reports in legal discussions.
